Policies

Approved stacks only  advisory  stack.blessed
Every app has an owner  advisory  owner.required
No unbounded refetch on user input  advisory  perf.unbounded-refetch
Apps use the org's design system  advisory  design.org-system
No user input reaching commands, files, pages or URLs  advisory  code.injection
Infrastructure config passes its benchmark checks  advisory  iac.misconfig
No hand-built SQL from user input (AI review)  advisory  ai.sql-string-concat
